title: Gate owner finalization on existing cross-repository integration reconciliation

reviewer_rejection_addressed.rejection_reason: Independent review rejects PR #5671 exact head c8c66eeab690dfba9b0d6243bb35c25abd2ddc31. P2: .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py:59-63 now silently maps malformed coordination values to an empty config, restoring DEFAULT_REPOSITORIES and violating acceptance 3 fail-closed registry resolution. Reproduced using the OPS-FE-REVIEW-PROOF-001 PR 747/head 598101a2b62395d4c39c19df619ebb4207ea8458 valid receipt fixture: config coordination=[bad-entry] or coordination=42 yields integration_receipt_consumes_candidate=True, is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending=False, and integration_candidates=[]; malformed registry configuration therefore appears reconciled, admits owner finalization, and hides the task from the sole integrator. The nested coordination.repositories=[bad-entry] control correctly returns False/True/one candidate. Required fix: distinguish allowed absent/default configuration from a present non-Mapping coordination value, reject malformed values through the existing fail-closed registry contract without crashing admission, and add deterministic consumer/admission parity regressions for these parent-container cases. Preserve the import-isolation fix.
fixes: Distinguished allowed absent/default configuration from a present non-Mapping coordination value in .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py:coordination_config, raising ValueError on malformed coordination values while returning {} on None/absent/Mapping.

Added explicit repositories(config_dict) validation at the start of validate_task_repository_scope so malformed registry configurations fail closed immediately across scope and admission checks without crashing admission.
Preserved import isolation in .orchestrator/dispatch_policy.py and hermetic test fixtures in test_status_command_runtime_pin.py and test_ai_status.py.

Added deterministic consumer and admission parity regressions in test_dispatch_policy.py for parent coordination container malformed cases ([], ['bad-entry'], 42, 'invalid') and allowed absent/default cases.
Added negative controls 6k and 6l in test_supervisor.py for parent coordination malformed cases.

criterion_1.statement: Implement the immutable plan/report referenced by this signed packet. Repair only the existing supervisor dispatch admission ladder; do not add a second scheduler, queue, cron, receipt store, status API, or integration path.
criterion_1.evidence: Repaired evaluate_task_delivery_admission in dispatch_policy.py to check is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending for OWNED_FINALIZE decisions. Reused existing multi-repo registry and canonical integration receipt validation without introducing any second scheduler, queue, cron, receipt store, or status API.

criterion_2.statement: For every configured non-default registry repository, an exact review_approved delivery with no current canonical integration receipt must not reserve owned_finalize_dispatch. It remains visible to the existing sole auto-integrator; once that existing receipt is current, normal owner closeout remains eligible.
criterion_2.evidence: Implemented is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending(config, task). For review_approved tasks targeting configured non-default repositories (such as execute-plans), admission returns eligible=False with TASK_NOT_DISPATCHABLE when unreceipted. Once a matching canonical integration receipt is recorded, owned_finalize_dispatch is admitted normally.

criterion_3.statement: Resolve target repository through the existing strict registry/receipt contract. Unknown/misconfigured repository ids, absent/malformed receipts, generation drift, changed PR/head/base or repository slug must fail closed and must not make a task appear reconciled.
criterion_3.evidence: task_has_current_canonical_integration_receipt delegates directly to integration_receipt.integration_receipt_consumes_candidate(task, config=config), using multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch. Distinguishes allowed absent/default configuration from present non-Mapping coordination values in coordination_config, raising ValueError and failing closed on malformed parent coordination values (e.g. lists, scalars) as well as nested repositories. Fails closed on unknown repository ids, non-mapping repositories list, invalid repository override types, explicit default_branch=None or empty, ambiguous/conflicting artifact paths, receipt version mismatch (!=1), invalid result (!=landed), unknown observation, receipt task_generation > current task generation, PR mismatch, head_sha mismatch, target_branch mismatch, missing merge_commit_sha, or delivery_binding mismatch.

criterion_4.statement: Add deterministic planner/admission coverage for the current OPS-FE-REVIEW-PROOF-001 binding: execute-plans PR #747/head 598101a2b62395d4c39c19df619ebb4207ea8458 with no receipt cannot consume the owner-finalize priority while OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 remains selectable. Cover normal unmerged Pantheon finalization and invalid/unknown registry negative controls.
criterion_4.evidence: Added test_planner_ops_fe_review_proof_unreceipted_does_not_starve_auto_integrator in test_supervisor.py and corresponding unit tests in test_dispatch_policy.py. Verifies execute-plans PR 747 / head 598101a2b62395d4c39c19df619ebb4207ea8458 with no receipt is blocked and cannot finalize, allowing OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 (in_progress) to be selected when max_concurrent_workers=1. Verified normal unmerged Pantheon finalization remains eligible, and verified negative controls for unknown repo, conflicting artifacts, malformed version, generation drift, repo drift, branch drift, malformed coordination parent container (list or scalar), malformed coordination.repositories list, malformed override value, explicit default_branch=None, and explicit repo=None.

criterion_5.statement: Compose with OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 without duplicating its writer/lock authority; rebase as needed, record exact tests/evidence, then deliver through the usual PR, independent review and sole integrator.
criterion_5.evidence: Reused the canonical config-aware predicate integration_receipt_consumes_candidate(task, config=config) across both the supervisor scheduler and the sole auto-integrator (passing config_dict in integration_candidates) without duplicating writer or lock authority. Proved consumer/admission parity across changed registry slug, custom repository with/without receipt, malformed parent coordination container, and malformed nested repository configuration, verifying agreement between scheduler admission and auto-integrator candidate selection.
